# == DO NOT EDIT THE FOLLOWING LINES for the Raspberry Pi Pico VS Code Extension to work ==
if(WIN32)
    set(USERHOME $ENV{USERPROFILE})
else()
    set(USERHOME $ENV{HOME})
endif()
set(sdkVersion 2.3.1)
set(toolchainVersion 15_2_Rel1)
set(picotoolVersion 2.3.1)
set(picoVscode ${USERHOME}/.pico-sdk/cmake/pico-vscode.cmake)
if (EXISTS ${picoVscode})
    include(${picoVscode})
endif()
# ====================================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

option(BUDDY4_HOST_TESTS "Build native tests without Pico SDK" OFF)
if(BUDDY4_HOST_TESTS)
    project(buddy4_host C)
    set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
    enable_testing()
    add_executable(buddy4_tests buddy4_imu.c tests/test_imu.c)
    target_include_directories(buddy4_tests PRIVATE .)
    target_compile_options(buddy4_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -UNDEBUG)
    target_link_libraries(buddy4_tests m)
    add_test(NAME buddy4_imu COMMAND buddy4_tests)
    return()
endif()
set(PICO_BOARD pico_w CACHE STRING "Board")
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)
project(buddy4 C CXX ASM)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
pico_sdk_init()
add_library(buddy4_imu STATIC buddy4_imu.c)
target_include_directories(buddy4_imu PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
target_link_libraries(buddy4_imu PUBLIC m)
add_executable(buddy4 main.c)
target_link_libraries(buddy4 PRIVATE buddy4_imu pico_stdlib hardware_i2c)
target_compile_definitions(buddy4 PRIVATE PICO_STDIO_USB_CONNECT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS=0 PICO_STDIO_USB_STDOUT_TIMEOUT_US=1000)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(buddy4 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(buddy4 0)
pico_add_extra_outputs(buddy4)
